g.text: SENSOR SUPPLY (section 13.5). One 5V terminal for flow meters with electronics, fed from V_BUCK:

g.desc: SENSOR SUPPLY (section 13.5). One 5V terminal for flow meters with electronics, fed from V_BUCK:

g.text: off on USB power. GPIO45 (SENS_PWR_EN, a strapping pin held low by R86) turns it on.

g.desc: off on USB power. GPIO45 (SENS_PWR_EN, a strapping pin held low by R86) turns it on.

g.text: U11 TPS2553 with R83 = 200k limits at 135 mA (116 to 158 mA) and reports on SENS_FLT_N.

g.desc: U11 TPS2553 with R83 = 200k limits at 135 mA (116 to 158 mA) and reports on SENS_FLT_N.

g.text: Terminal voltage about 4.8 V at 20 mA, 4.5 V at 50 mA. Treat 100 mA as the usable current.

g.desc: Terminal voltage about 4.8 V at 20 mA, 4.5 V at 50 mA. Treat 100 mA as the usable current.

g.text: D19 blocks a +45 V miswire. D20 clamps a negative one and F3 (0.2 A hold) trips.

g.desc: D19 blocks a +45 V miswire. D20 clamps a negative one and F3 (0.2 A hold) trips.

g.text: D24 keeps the OUT pin of U11 above -0.3 V while F3 is tripping.

g.desc: D24 keeps the OUT pin of U11 above -0.3 V while F3 is tripping.

g.text: Three sensor inputs: RAIN, FLOW, AUX

g.desc: Three sensor inputs: RAIN, FLOW, AUX

g.text: Each terminal has a 10k pull-up to V5 (0.5 mA wetting

g.desc: Each terminal has a 10k pull-up to V5 (0.5 mA wetting

g.text: current), 10k in series, a BAT54S clamp to 3V3 and GND,

g.desc: current), 10k in series, a BAT54S clamp to 3V3 and GND,

g.text: 22 nF and 1k into the GPIO. A closed contact or an

g.desc: 22 nF and 1k into the GPIO. A closed contact or an

g.text: open-collector sensor reads low. The filter passes 200 Hz.

g.desc: open-collector sensor reads low. The filter passes 200 Hz.

g.text: It does not remove the 1 to 2 ms bounce of a reed-switch

g.desc: It does not remove the 1 to 2 ms bounce of a reed-switch

g.text: 32 VAC on a signal terminal for ever is survived: the TVS

g.desc: 32 VAC on a signal terminal for ever is survived: the TVS

g.text: does not conduct below 48 V, and the pull-up and series

g.desc: does not conduct below 48 V, and the pull-up and series

g.text: resistors are 1206 parts rated 200 V that dissipate 0.11 W.

g.desc: resistors are 1206 parts rated 200 V that dissipate 0.11 W.

g.text: The clamp passes 4.2 mA peak into 3V3.

g.desc: The clamp passes 4.2 mA peak into 3V3.

g.text: D12, D13, D14, D18: SMBJ48CA at each field terminal,

g.desc: D12, D13, D14, D18: SMBJ48CA at each field terminal,
